fact: In the commune of Lacs 1 (Aného) an application named Kadodo, retained from a 2020 UNDP Accelerator Lab challenge and equipped and trained for by UNDP, records civil status acts (births, deaths, marriages) with real-time data sharing between health centres and the town hall's civil status service; 1,975 births were registered in 2020 against 700 in 2019.
title: Chaque nom compte : La digitalisation des actes d’état civil, une expérience du PNUD dans les Communes
publisher: Programme des Nations Unies pour le développement (PNUD) Togo
